description_en: Inserts a video file during a voice call
description_zh: 在语音通话中插播视频文件
name: PlayVideoFile

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the video file to insert.

You can view the IDs of approved videos on the Video Insert Files (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/videoFiles/list/slot) page
parameters.help_zh:
视频插播文件ID。

您可以在视频插播文件 (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/videoFiles/list/slot)页面查看审核通过的视频ID
parameters.name: video_id

parameters.help_en: The phone number that receives the video playback
parameters.help_zh: 接收视频播放的手机号码
parameters.name: called_number

parameters.help_en:
The call ID. You can obtain the CallId from the response parameters of the SingleCallByVideo (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/vms/developer-reference/api-dyvmsapi-2017-05-25-singlecallbyvideo) operation.

You can use the CallId to call the QueryVideoPlayProgress (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/vms/developer-reference/api-dyvmsapi-2017-05-25-queryvideoplayprogress) operation to view the video playback progress
parameters.help_zh:
通话一ID。您可以在SingleCallByVideo (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/vms/developer-reference/api-dyvmsapi-2017-05-25-singlecallbyvideo?spm)接口返回参数中获取CallId。

您可以使用CallId，调用QueryVideoPlayProgress (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/vms/developer-reference/api-dyvmsapi-2017-05-25-queryvideoplayprogress?spm)接口查看视频播放进度
parameters.name: call_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID reserved for the caller. This ID is returned to the caller in the receipt message.

The value is a string with a length of 1 to 15 characters
parameters.help_zh:
预留给调用方的ID，最终会通过回执消息将此ID带回给调用方。

字符串类型，长度限制为1~15个字符
parameters.name: out_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to play the video only on the mobile phone. Valid values:

true

false (default)
parameters.help_zh:
仅在手机端播放视频。取值：

true

false（默认值）
parameters.name: only_phone

Code.description_en:
The request status code.
OK indicates that the request was successful.
For other error codes, see [API error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/112502.html）
Code.description_zh:
请求状态码。
返回OK代表请求成功。
其他错误码，请参见[API错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/112502.html）

Model.description_en:
The call type. Valid values:

video

voice

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the API call was successful. Valid values:

true

false
Success.description_zh:
接口调用是否成功。

true

false
